placements.title: Immediate Receipt Return Replaces Blocking Calls with Asynchronous Polling
placements.frame: How does immediate receipt issuance with decoupled tracking prevent blocking and dropped work across async operations?
placements.why: Wynn and Xena record the ratification and core operational logic of the async job contract, establishing that dispatch calls return receipts immediately while downstream extraction is tracked asynchronously via cursor polling or piggybacked responses to prevent blocking and state loss.
